bootstrap.pairing: per-qid Phase 7 minus Phase 6 deltas aggregated at connected-group level
bootstrap.underpowered_behavior: fail closed with insufficient_independent_groups; no PASS or zero-filled estimate

retrieval_metrics.query_hit_recall_at_k: positive query with >=1 unique gold chunk in top k / positive queries
retrieval_metrics.all_gold_recall_at_k: positive query with every unique gold chunk in top k / positive queries
retrieval_metrics.evidence_recall_at_k: unique gold chunks retrieved / unique gold chunks expected
retrieval_metrics.mrr: mean reciprocal rank of first unique gold chunk per answerable query
retrieval_metrics.ndcg: graded ranking metric from unique gold evidence; denominator recomputed by validator

guardrails.duplicate_gold_evidence: deduplicate by provenance identity before denominator
guardrails.missing_answerable_evidence: invalid input; never convert to an empty/zero denominator
guardrails.negative_rows: count separately for false-positive/answer behavior; not included in positive recall denominator
guardrails.provider_errors: not successful answers and not omitted from operational denominators

limitations: The protocol is locked in code/tests for the current Phase 7 release contract; it does not mean a fresh benchmark with adequate groups has been frozen.
Current r18 official result remains 3/19 gates passed; M2 failed and no release score is available.
